message.content: On September 16th, 2026, WolfgangSchulz suggested incorporating improvisational solos into their practice sessions. He proposed this idea because he believed it could boost their jazz fusion skills and make the sessions more fun and creative. LiHua enthusiastically supported this suggestion, agreeing that improvisation would add a layer of challenge and growth to their musical development. They were excited to see what each member would contribute and look forward to trying out the new approach.
